thread:
Maya: Heads-up — Aster Health's EU demo is getting 403s on inference requests after the routing change earlier today. Customer says it works from US region but fails when their EU users hit the edge.
Sam: Do we have any logs or sample request IDs?
Maya: Yes, they sent a sample request id `req_2024_aster_0831`. Error in proxy logs shows missing expected header and then 403.
Carlos: (Aster) Confirming — our QA hit the demo from Amsterdam and got 403s repeatedly. We didn't change anything client-side.
Jen: Possible culprit: header-based allowlist for the EU peering config. We recently tightened allowed inbound headers for EU to block unexpected traffic.
Sam: If it's header-based, we can add their app-origin header as an exception temporarily. What's the header they send?
Carlos: They use `X-Aster-App: demo-portal` in every request.
Maya: Proposed actions: 1) Add header exception for `X-Aster-App: demo-portal` in EU peering rule. 2) Temporarily raise their per-route QPS from 80 -> 250 for the next 48h to cover demos. 3) Kick off a short enablement call to walk their SRE through best practices.
Jen: I can make the header exception and the QPS bump — will need an approval from infra for temporary SLA change.
Sam: Approving the temporary QPS bump for 48h for renewal-demo. Adding note to account: "High renewal risk if demo can't be validated".
Maya: tagging @Sam and @Jen — can you do the change now? Customer is on a scheduled investor demo in 2h. :grimacing:
ops-bot: Incident created — INC-2024-8341 assigned to eng-infra for review (priority: P2).
Jen: Done — added header-based allowlist rule on EU peering for `X-Aster-App: demo-portal`. Increased route limit to 250 QPS and set auto-revert at 48h.
Sam: Confirmed from logs: EU requests from Carlos's IP now return 200s.
Carlos: Verified — demo portal is green. Huge thanks, team.
Maya: Great. Follow-ups: schedule 30-min enablement call today to document production headers+backoff settings; capture feedback about the onboarding docs. Also add a renewal flag on the account and loop in AM.
Carlos: Please cc our tech lead Lina (lina@aster.health) on the enablement call.
Maya: Will do. Adding Lina and AM to the calendar invite. :thumbsup:
Jen: I'll add a short blurb to internal postmortem: tighten header rules require pre-onboarding header whitelists for regioned peering.
Maya: Closing thread — thanks everyone.
